sentences.en: That big busted blonde is as dumb as a rock.
sentences.zh: 那个大胸金发女郎笨得像块石头。

sentences.en: The dumb masses believe that Mandela was a decent man.
sentences.zh: 那些愚昧的大众相信曼德拉是个好人。

sentences.en: Dan couldn't believe that Linda could do something that dumb.
sentences.zh: 丹不敢相信琳达竟然会做出这么蠢的事。
